title_zh: 图书馆续借逾期图书并预约保留

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to renew these two books, please. Are they overdue?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.en: Let me check… Yes, one is three days overdue, so there'll be a small late fee. I can renew both for another two weeks, though.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: That's fine. How much is the fine?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.en: It's two dollars. Also, did you want me to put this title on reserve for you? Someone just returned a copy.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, please. Can I check it out today?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.en: Sure. Here's your receipt — the new due date is November 12th.

expressions.zh: 过期未还／逾期。剑桥例句：*My library books are a week overdue.*

expressions.en: put something on reserve / check out (a book)
expressions.zh: 预约保留／从图书馆借出（书）。
